dedupe_keys.name: investigating the behavior of nonconforming rc shear walls with smooth bars in old and existing buildings

description: Investigating the behavior of nonconforming RC shear walls with smooth bars in old and existing buildings is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Muhammed Nadir Olabi, Bolu Abant zzat Baysal University. In this project, an experimental investigation is conducted to determine the behavior of RC shear walls found in old and existing buildings that do not comply with the design rules in modern earthquake standards. Many studies indicated that most of the damaged buildings after earthquake events were built with low concrete quality and smooth bars. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Experimental study, Nonconforming RC shear wall, Smooth reinforcement bar, Cyclic load, Bar slip. Published 2022-10-07. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
